description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for batch processing with progressive UI updates. It manages processing large sets of items in batches, providing progress callbacks and cancellation capabilities, leveraging requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallbacks.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items in a progressive manner, utilizing requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, with start and cancel functions and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, managing UI state related to progress and providing functions to start processing from a list of items and cancel ongoing processing.
